_why: MINIMAL VALID create body for ScreenTemplate.
ScreenTemplateDtoValidator requires Id NotEmpty, Title a non-empty LocalizedString, and
Questions NotEmpty ('Screen templates must contain at least one question reference').
Each QuestionRefDto requires a non-empty bankRef.
bankRef points at a SEEDED BankQuestion key, so the reference resolves against real data
rather than dangling - a dangling ref is how this body would 4xx and silently cover nothing.
